proposedFix: To unblock: price a EUR Services line with Italy Ship_To_Place through the Salesforce UI (add EFT Expert Service Enterprise to an EUR Italy quote via UI, save+reprice, then re-run headless Force-reprice to measure V21 output). Structural risk identified: V21 Currency Conversion steps (RegionalNetTotalSubtotal seq=37, RegionalNetUnitPrice seq=35, RegionalTotalLineAmount seq=38, UnitPriceDisplay seq=36) unconditionally apply EUR_rate=0.9346 multiplier AFTER the Regional Services Price ListContainer4 (seq=11). If the prehook successfully writes RegionalNetUnitPrice__c=32900 (CEILING(51403*0.64/5)*5) and step 104 assigns it to InputUnitPrice, the Currency Conversion - Unit Price Display step would then compute 32900*0.9346=30740 EUR — incorrect double-FX. A fix would require either: (A) gating Currency Conversion steps to skip lines where AllowRegionalPricing__c=true and RegionalNetUnitPrice__c is non-null (already EUR), or (B) having the prehook work from USD catalog (55000) so Currency Conversion correctly converts to EUR (55000*0.9346=51403, then 51403*0.64=32899, rounded to 32900).
notes: Run3 re-measurement 2026-06-30. V21 active today with LastModifiedDate=2026-06-30T05:56:48Z (modified in-place). The G-01 EUR US-country Services reprice (UnitPrice=467.3 unchanged, Regional_NetUnit_Price__c=null) suggests null-safe step-104 assignment and no Currency Conversion impact for the US=1.0 path (no regional scaling occurred).
